dedupe_keys.name: italian railway network dataset with multi type train operation records and scheduling

description: This dataset describes the Italian railway network through the operation records of 3,324 trains of several categories (high-speed, regional and intercity) at 1,397 stations from 1 January to 30 June 2024. It combines scheduled and actual times with train fault information, station locations and inter-station mileage, and adds weather conditions and major holidays as factors. The operation records were collected through TrainStats, a service that downloads daily records from ViaggiaTreno, the real-time information site of the Italian railway operator. Four CSV files hold train operation data (about 412 MB), train fault information, adjacent station mileage and station locations. It was produced by Jianqing Wu and colleagues at Jiangxi University of Science and Technology with co-authors in Australia and China, and described in Scientific Data in December 2025. Coverage is the national network of Italy. Access: free download from figshare under CC BY 4.0 (version 2, November 2025). Caveats: the period is six months, and the data come from a third-party collection of public real-time information, not from the operator. It supports delay propagation, timetable robustness and resilience analysis of a mixed-traffic rail network, and complements the Chinese high-speed railway dataset and the Italian MIT open data catalogued here.
